changeHypothesis.summary: TrendForce projected Q4 DRAM contract-price declines and a 2022 downswing as buyer procurement weakened and inventories rose. The physical signal was negative, so backward-looking semiconductor earnings could not justify bottom-fishing without a differentiated company path.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Inventory normalization and contract-price cycles extend over multiple quarters.
disconfirmingEvidence: All three frozen memory names had negative 20d relative returns.
No company-specific path evidence overcame the negative physical cycle at the event cutoff.
